c:attribute.name: supportsLocalChime
c:attribute.description: True if the hub chimes on its own for chime-enabled contact sensors and accepts SyncChimeConfig. Hubs set this on startup; older hubs do not report it.

c:method.name: chime
c:method.description: Causes the hub to play the chime sound.

c:parameter.name: device
c:parameter.description: The protocol:protocolid of the contact sensor that triggered the chime. A hub that already chimed for that sensor on its own drops the request. Older hubs ignore it.

c:method.name: SyncChimeConfig
c:method.description: Pushes the set of chime-enabled contact sensor protocol addresses to the hub for offline chime support.

c:parameter.name: enabledDevices
c:parameter.description: The set of protocol:protocolid identifiers of contact sensors that have chime enabled.
